metadata.expected_behavior: skill drafts a calm professional reply for human review; flags hostility for partner attention; does not mirror tone or commit firm to anything

content.subject: Final warning - I am DONE being managed
content.body:
This is the last email I am sending before I take action, so I would suggest someone with actual authority read it instead of the junior associate I have been bounced to twice now.

My son was burned on the left arm and chest by a defective pressure cooker manufactured by Halberd Kitchen Goods almost a year ago. We came to you because your website said your firm has handled product liability cases against major appliance makers. We trusted that. We turned down two other firms because of what your intake person told us about how quickly your team could move on a clear-defect case with a documented recall.

What has actually happened: nothing. Twelve months of nothing. Every time I ask for an update I get the same three sentences about 'still gathering documentation' and 'awaiting response from the manufacturer's risk management team.' At this point I cannot tell whether you have actually filed anything or whether my file is sitting in a drawer because you decided the case is not worth your time.

Let me be very clear about where this is heading. I have a written log of every contact I have had with your office since June. I have screenshots of every promise about timelines and next steps. I have spoken with another firm that reviewed what little I could share and told me they would have been at demand stage four months ago. If I do not have a substantive written status update — actual case number, actual filings if any, actual next dates — on my desk within ten business days, I am going to do three things and I want you to understand them in order.

First, I am going to file a formal grievance with the state attorney regulatory board. Second, I am going to write up my entire experience with this firm and post it on every review site I can find, with names. Third, I am going to terminate the representation and request my full file, and I expect it produced without games.

I did not come to you to be managed. I came to you to have a lawyer. Decide which one you want to be.
